map.转弯率和转弯半径什么关系？: What's the relation between turn rate and turn radius?
map.ω=V/R，半径越小或速度越大角速度越大。本工具由 V 与 φ 直接算 ω；与转: ω=V/R, so a smaller radius or higher speed gives a larger angular velocity. This tool computes ω directly from V and φ; it complements the turn-radius tool (one shows 'how fast it turns', the other 'how big the loop is').
map.速度越慢转弯率越大吗？: Is a slower speed a higher turn rate?
map.对，ω∝1/V。同一坡度低速转得更快（角速度大），但半径也更小。低速大坡度易超结: Yes, ω∝1/V. At the same bank a lower speed turns faster (larger angular velocity) but with a smaller radius. Low speed with large bank can exceed structural limits, so check load-factor limits too.
